description: Adds a place to the person’s Remap, or updates one when id is given. A new place needs kind, name and where it is: place text Remap can find, or lng and lat. A note is appended to the place’s note, never replacing it; put dates and memories there.

id.description: A kept place’s id from list_places.

kind.description: home, work, school, regular (somewhere they go), want_to_go (a place, ride or trip they want to do), visited (a past trip, ride or stay) or other.

lat.description: Start latitude in degrees, when the start is known as a coordinate.

lng.description: Start longitude in degrees, when the start is known as a coordinate.

name.description: What the person calls the place.

note.description: Appended to the place’s note: dates, memories, why it matters.

place.description: Where the place is, as text Remap can find (an address, a park, a town).

name: add_place
title: Add or update a Remap place
